memories.summary: Mara is a nurse who works night shifts at a hospital referred to as 'the General'.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: hospital where Mara works night shifts

memories.summary: Mara moved to Toronto about three weeks before 2026-03-22, into a small apartment of her own in the Parkdale neighbourhood, and still feels like a tourist in her own home.

entities.name: Parkdale
entities.description: Toronto neighbourhood where Mara's apartment is

memories.summary: Mara misses Halifax, where she lived before moving to Toronto, and especially misses Sandra, a colleague she used to debrief with after every shift; they now only keep in touch by text, which Mara feels isn't the same.

entities.name: Sandra
entities.description: Mara's former nursing colleague in Halifax

memories.summary: Daniel, Mara's partner, lives in Vancouver, and the time-zone gap means they struggle to connect, basically only catching each other briefly across the day.

Mara is lonely and isolated after her move to Toronto, lying awake around 2-4am after night shifts with circadian rhythm disrupted, leaning on the companion just to say her feelings out loud to someone.
Mara has a cat named Jollof, who moved with her to the Toronto apartment and has claimed the windowsill.
